error[ZBX-E1001]: this zbx is not allowed to run virtual machines
  cause  Virtualization.framework refused: The process doesn't have the
         "com.apple.security.virtualization" entitlement.
  fix    sign this zbx with the virtualization entitlement:   codesign -f -s - --entitlements vm/zbx.entitlements $(which zbx)
         or install a release build, which is signed already
  more   zbx explain E1001 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1001.html
